current_focus.domain: Runnable EmDash website scaffold and shared account boundaries
current_focus.summary: Create and publish the bounded DinkusKit EmDash website scaffold, with local runtime/build/type/public-safety proof. Preserve existing-site-first, Registry plugins, shared identity with explicit site grants, native blocks, and trial-without-card direction. Authentication proof is the next slice; production hosting, service activation, billing and portal UI are not part of this scaffold. The user explicitly requested the repository and previously authorized opening PRs without waiting on review rails.

decisions.choice: EmDash powers the public DinkusKit website, using upstream native blocks and independent repository history. Do not depend on the retiring dinkuskit/blocks package.
